paper.title_en: Radiative Signatures from Warp Drives Traveling Through the Earth's Atmosphere
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the observable signatures of zero ADM mass warp drive spacetimes traversing Earth's atmosphere. Numerical simulations indicate that an aircraft-scale spacetime bubble moving at relativistic velocities would have a pronounced observational signature, where interaction with the atmosphere can produce luminosities exceeding one terawatt. The signature of a spacetime bubble at rest or moving at low velocity relative to the Earth would not generate such extreme luminosities. These results establish observational constraints on spacetime-based propulsion operating within the terrestrial environment and provide a framework for identifying potential high-velocity signatures. In particular, a warp drive traveling through the atmosphere at speeds exceeding approximately 10% of the speed of light would produce a unique brilliant glow.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了曲速引擎时空在大气中的辐射特征，属于广义相对论的基础应用，具有理论深度和新颖性，且为近期工作，虽无引用但按规则不扣分。
decision.title_zh: 地球大气层中穿越的曲速引擎的辐射特征
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了零ADM质量的曲速引擎时空穿越地球大气层时的可观测特征。数值模拟表明，一个飞行器尺度的时空泡以相对论速度运动时，会产生明显的观测特征，其中与大气层的相互作用可产生超过一太瓦的光度。一个相对于地球静止或低速运动的时空泡的特征不会产生如此极端的光度。这些结果为在地球环境中基于时空的推进建立了观测约束，并为识别潜在的高速特征提供了一个框架。特别是，一个以超过光速约10%的速度穿越大气层的曲速引擎会产生独特的明亮光芒。
